harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, verified at runtime, and confirmed persistence across a full node reboot (boot_id changed).
actions_performed: Captured pre-change baseline sysctl values for accept_redirects and accept_source_route (all/default) on node1
Applied settings immediately with sysctl -p and sysctl --system
Verified runtime sysctl values and per-interface /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/ values reflect the hardened settings
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime as healthy baseline
Issued a native reboot on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity resumed
Confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified persistent config file and runtime sysctl/proc values post-restart to confirm settings survived the reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-change sysctl values captured on node1
evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 (all/default) needing hardening; accept_source_route already 0

evidence.requirement: Persistent sysctl config applied and runtime values set to disabled
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl -p and --system, confirmed runtime values all 0

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline / boot identity capture

evidence.summary: Reboot command scheduled and acknowledged; subsequent poll (cmd-25605b524b2b426b) shows node offline

evidence.requirement: Node restart availability polling and changed boot identity proof
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id 02412f2f-8bc5-4e1f-9854-93834fe28500, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence verification of hardening setting
evidence.summary: Confirmed new boot_id, persistent config file intact, and sysctl/proc values for accept_redirects and accept_source_route (all/default/eth0) remained 0 after reboot
